node.statement: Endpoint check for the nonvanishing case: the live validated statement of node 1.2 assumes e<=e_ca. Since e<=e_sq and e_sq=min{e_ca,e_v,1/(2*max{1,C_ca})}, one has e<=e_sq<=e_ca. Therefore node 1.2 applies even when e=e_sq=e_ca and yields ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-C_ca*e)||Z||^2=(1-K_sq*e)||Z||^2 because K_sq=C_ca; no boundary point is omitted.
